e.title: Neo4j Graph Data Science
e.summary: 图数据科学平台：欺诈团伙识别/关联网络分析，Zurich 等保险反欺诈生产案例
e.body: Neo4j Graph Data Science（GDS）是图数据库之上的图分析平台：图嵌入（FastRP）、社区检测、PageRank 等算法库，保险反欺诈（欺诈团伙识别、关联网络挖掘）有 Zurich Insurance 等生产案例。对 RIAA：图分析在保险的核心应用——团伙欺诈是单条规则抓不住的结构化风险（同 [[aws-fraud-graph]]、[[insurax]] 的图分析谱系）；「投保人-代理人-受益人-车辆」关联网络建模的通用平台；配合 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（规则+ML）做多层欺诈防线；图数据库课程/反欺诈项目的标准栈。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：Neo4j 官方页确认（GDS 算法库 + Zurich 保险案例），未实测
e.summary_en: Graph data science platform: fraud-ring detection and relational-network analytics, production cases in insurance (Zurich)
e.summary_hk: 圖數據科學平台：欺詐團夥識別/關聯網絡分析，Zurich 等保險反欺詐生產案例
e.body_en: Neo4j Graph Data Science (GDS) is a graph-analytics platform on top of the graph database: algorithms for graph embeddings (FastRP), community detection, PageRank and more, with production insurance anti-fraud cases (fraud-ring detection, relational-network mining) such as [[zurich|Zurich Insurance]]. For RIAA: the core application of graph analytics in insurance — ring fraud is structural risk that single rules cannot catch (sharing the graph lineage of [[aws-fraud-graph]] and [[insurax]]); a general platform for modelling policyholder-agent-beneficiary-vehicle networks; with [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (rules+ML) it forms a multi-layer fraud defence; the standard stack for graph-database courses and anti-fraud projects.
e.body_hk: Neo4j Graph Data Science（GDS）是圖數據庫之上的圖分析平台：圖嵌入（FastRP）、社區檢測、PageRank 等算法庫，保險反欺詐（欺詐團夥識別、關聯網絡挖掘）有 Zurich Insurance 等生產案例。對 RIAA：圖分析在保險的核心應用——團夥欺詐是單條規則抓不住的結構化風險（同 [[aws-fraud-graph]]、[[insurax]] 的圖分析譜系）；「投保人-代理人-受益人-車輛」關聯網絡建模的通用平台；配合 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（規則+ML）做多層欺詐防線；圖數據庫課程/反欺詐項目的標準棧。
